Scene:
古代的时候，孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家。孩子才五岁就每天在墓地祭拜了。在那个城市，孟母从早到晚都找工作，可是找不到，害得孟母没有钱。难怪她跟孩子搬家，原来买不了房。他们搬了到别一个城市找工作。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 古代的时候，孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家：在古代，better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears；住在靠近墓地的地方/墓地附近，delete了，在+Place
- 孩子才五岁就每天在墓地祭拜了：孟子，孩子is vague and unclear
- 难怪她跟孩子搬家，原来买不了房：wrong information, 搬家因为孟母觉得it is not good to imitate how to offer sacrifices
- 他们搬了到别一个城市找工作：搬到了，另外一个城市，“别（的）” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: Coherence (Reference): 孟子和孟母：有一个小男孩叫孟子，他和妈妈，first mentions should introduce the character clearly with a name and identity before using a shorter reference. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
Run 2: 住了在靠墓地的家：住在靠近墓地的家里，a location phrase follows the verb directly; the aspect marker cannot appear before the preposition. [teacher rule: le_placement]
Run 3: Coherence (Reference): 孟子和孟母：有一个小男孩叫孟子，他和妈妈，This is the first mention of the main character, so introduce him with his name and identity before using later references. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]

output.reason: Runs 1 and 3 address unclear first character introduction, while Run 2 corrects the placement of 了 in the location phrase.
